detail.longDescription:
Attached: 1 image

Big lists just got easier to scan: group by type, folder, site, date or letter

- New Group by menu under Sort by: group any list by type, folder, website, date or first letter, independently of sort order (including Size).
- Pinned tabs sync in order across all your devices; unpinned tabs stay local.
- Lists with pinned items now get a foldable Pinned header.

Try it, no account: https://try.privacynotes.app

#notes #productivity #privacy
